The single-line PubMed query is saved in [final_strategy.txt](C:/Users/aaron/AppData/Local/Temp/psb-evals/run-3d10494d5653b6c0/lean-optimal-codex-noseed-20260927T101600Z/final_strategy.txt). The search log and MeSH notes are in [strategy_notes.md](C:/Users/aaron/AppData/Local/Temp/psb-evals/run-3d10494d5653b6c0/lean-optimal-codex-noseed-20260927T101600Z/work/strategy_notes.md).

The query uses two essential blocks: nursing students/nursing education and virtual reality or virtual simulation. It omits comparator, outcome, and study-design terms to preserve recall; screen for those eligibility criteria afterward. With publication and PubMed entry dates limited through 2023-03-31, the live PubMed search returned **737 records**. No seed PMIDs were available for validation.

One MeSH caveat: PubMed recognizes “Virtual Reality” as a MeSH term, but the current descriptor lookup resolves that wording inconsistently, including to a therapy-specific heading. I retained the literal heading and documented the uncertainty in the work log. The query was executed against today’s live index with date limits; current indexing may differ from a historical PubMed snapshot.

This is a draft for peer review by a second information specialist using PRESS before final use. It covers PubMed only; translate the strategy for other databases and report any additional searches and limits under PRISMA-S.
